description: Relocate the none-backend issue-close from ship-finalize (branch) to the post-merge step on main, with robust string/number issueNumber resolution (never <prefix>-0) threaded via .cam-merge-watch.json; subsumes CAM-113.

userStories.title: Add resolveIssueId helper (string or numeric issueNumber, never <prefix>-0)
userStories.description: As the cam ship pipeline, I need a single pure resolver that turns a prd.issueNumber (a full string id like 'CAM-154' OR a bare number like 42) into the canonical issue id, returning null instead of a phantom '<prefix>-0' when it cannot resolve, so every downstream close path anchors to the real issue.
acceptanceCriteria: resolveIssueId('CAM-154', 'CAM') returns 'CAM-154': a string matching /^[A-Z]+-[0-9]+$/ is returned verbatim, never Number()-parsed. [oracle: bun test]
resolveIssueId(42, 'CAM') returns 'CAM-42': a numeric issueNumber composes as prefix-n. [oracle: bun test]
resolveIssueId(null | undefined | '' | 'not-an-id', 'CAM') returns null and NEVER '<prefix>-0', so no phantom id is produced from any non-null issueNumber. [oracle: bun test]
resolveIssueId is exported and pure (no filesystem, git, or process access). [oracle: grep -q 'export function resolveIssueId' src/issues/resolve-id.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: New file src/issues/resolve-id.ts + test/issues/resolve-id.test.ts. Match string ids with /^[A-Z]+-[0-9]+$/ and return verbatim; compose numeric as `${prefix}-${n}`. This is the CAM-113 root-cause fix (ship-finalize.ts:131 typeof==='number' guard rejects the anchored string id -> null -> '<prefix>-0'). noUncheckedIndexedAccess: guard regex .exec() results. Signature accepts number | string | null | undefined; prefix is a param (do NOT read project.toml here).

userStories.title: Thread an issueId through the merge-watch state schema
userStories.description: As the post-merge close path, I need the merge-watch state file (.cam-merge-watch.json) to carry the resolved target issue id, plus a stash helper that writes it before the PR exists, so both the sidecar (ci-gated) and the orchestrator (immediate) can close the issue after merge without re-reading prd.json.
acceptanceCriteria: MergeWatchState gains an optional issueId?: string field; readMergeWatchState parses it and writeMergeWatchState re-emits it so it survives every sidecar tick. [oracle: bun test]

A new stashIssueIdInMergeWatch(filePath, issueId) helper writes issueId into .cam-merge-watch.json, read-modify-write preserving any existing prNumber/mergedBranch/pollCount, and creating the file when absent. [oracle: bun test]

readMergeWatchState still returns null for an issueId-only file (no prNumber), so a pre-PR stash reads back as 'no active watch' and the sidecar stays inert until the PR is created. [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: src/release/merge-watch.ts (MergeWatchState interface, readMergeWatchState/writeMergeWatchState, new stashIssueIdInMergeWatch) + test/release/merge-watch.test.ts. MERGE_WATCH_FILENAME already exists. KEEP readMergeWatchState's existing prNumber:number + mergedBranch:string requirement (returns null otherwise); only ADD issueId as optional. Follow the JSON-reader shape-guard pattern (validate discriminator fields, not just typeof object). Single-writer assumption holds. Shared-state schema change that US-004 (write) and US-005 (read) depend on.

userStories.title: Add closeIssueOnMain on-main commit-tree close primitive
userStories.description: As the deterministic post-merge step, I need a primitive that sets stage:'shipped' on a target issue via the commit-tree-to-main plumbing (never the working tree) and fails loud when the issue is missing, so a stale branch index can never clobber the backlog and a mis-resolved id can never silently close nothing.
acceptanceCriteria: closeIssueOnMain({ cwd, id, spawnFn, clock }) sets stage:'shipped' on the target issue and commits ONLY scripts/cam/issues/<id>.json to main via commitTreeToMain (tree derived from the main ref), then pushes main best-effort. [oracle: bun test]
closeIssueOnMain fails loud when the id is absent on main: returns { ok: false, reason: 'not-found' } (never a silent ok), mirroring abandonIssueOnMain's not-found contract. [oracle: bun test]
closeIssueOnMain reuses the up-to-date guard and returns { ok: false, reason: 'detached-head' | 'missing-main' | 'diverged' } without mutating anything on those failures. [oracle: bun test]
closeIssueOnMain is exported from src/commands/issue-specify.ts. [oracle: grep -q 'export function closeIssueOnMain' src/commands/issue-specify.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: src/commands/issue-specify.ts (mirror abandonIssueOnMain: reuse checkMainUpToDate, readBacklogFromMain(toBacklogSpawn(spawnFn)), commitTreeToMain(..., 'cam-specify-'), pushMainBestEffort) + tests in test/issue-specify.test.ts (real-git integration + unit fakes per CAM-72 pattern). Add CloseIssueOnMainOptions/Outcome types mirroring the Abandon* discriminated unions. Commit message: chore(cam): close <id> (shipped). GOTCHA (CAM-133): commitTreeToMain reads the tree from read-tree main, never the working tree; do NOT readFileSync the working-tree issue copy. spawnSync exit-status guard is already inside commitTreeToMain. issue-specify.ts is 531 lines with no explicit file-size budget entry; if check:all trips a ceiling, US-006 raises it with _ref CAM-121.

userStories.title: Stop closing the issue in ship-finalize; stash the resolved issueId instead
userStories.description: As ship-finalize, I need to stop writing stage:'shipped' to the branch copy of the issue file and instead resolve the target issue id and stash it into .cam-merge-watch.json before I remove prd.json, keeping only the per-branch harness-state cleanup, so the squash-merge can never clobber the backlog and the close is deferred to post-merge.
acceptanceCriteria: finalizeCycleClose no longer reads or writes any scripts/cam/issues/ file: a finalize run leaves the target issue's status and stage byte-for-byte untouched. [oracle: bun test asserting the issue-writer seam is never invoked and the issue file is unchanged]
finalizeCycleClose still removes scripts/cam/prd.json, handoff.json, and progress.txt via git rm and commits the cycle-close on the branch (unchanged). [oracle: bun test]

finalizeCycleClose resolves the target id via resolveIssueId (string OR numeric issueNumber) and calls stashIssueIdInMergeWatch BEFORE the prd.json git rm; when issueNumber is non-null but unresolvable it fails loud (throws / non-zero exit), never stashing a phantom '<prefix>-0'. [oracle: bun test]

finalizeCycleClose issues NO git push to main (the branch commit is the only write), so a none-backend ship cannot put the open PR BEHIND because of the close. [oracle: bun test asserting no spawn call is a git push to main]
github and linear backends are unchanged: finalize does only git rm + branch commit for them and touches no issue file (no regression). [oracle: bun test]

Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]

userStories.title: Close the none-backend issue on main in the ci-gated post-merge
userStories.description: As the sidecar's ci-gated post-merge, I need runPostMerge to close the target issue on main (stage:'shipped') after the tag/prune, reading the issueId threaded through the merge-watch state, so the none-backend issue is closed exactly once, post-merge, by construction.
acceptanceCriteria: runPostMerge accepts an optional closeIssueId?: string and, after the tag + branch prune succeed on main, calls closeIssueOnMain via an injectable seam; the PostMergeOutcome surfaces the close result. [oracle: bun test]

When closeIssueId is present but closeIssueOnMain returns not-found, runPostMerge surfaces the failure loudly (a close-failed reason/field plus an error log or event), never a silent success. [oracle: bun test]
When closeIssueId is absent (github/linear, or no threaded id), runPostMerge attempts no close and behaves exactly as before (no regression). [oracle: bun test]
The sidecar reads state.issueId from the merge-watch state and passes it as closeIssueId into the runPostMerge invocation on the MERGED path. [oracle: grep -q 'issueId' src/commands/sidecar.ts]

Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
